meta.title: Number Merge
meta.instructions: Swipe or use the arrow keys to slide tiles. Equal tiles merge. Reach 128.

art.style: Risograph print: cream paper with grain, pink-teal-blue ink blobs, halftone tiles with misregistered shadows.
